input:
Our hardware watchdog NMI is not being delivered on a GICv3.3 system. The watchdog is configured to fire a non-maskable interrupt when the CPU lockup is detected, but the NMI handler is never called during a simulated CPU hang.

dmesg (before hang):
  [  0.500] GICv3: Using GICv3.3 NMI support (FEAT_GICv3_NMI detected)
  [  0.501] watchdog: nmi_watchdog_setup: marking SPI 32 as NMI via GICD_INMIR0
  [  0.502] GICv3-NMI: SPI 32 configured as non-maskable in GICD_INMIR0
  ... (system hangs, no crash dump, no NMI handler invocation)

ID_AA64PFR1_EL1 readout:
  NMI field = 0b0000  (FEAT_NMI NOT implemented on this PE)

The kernel shows GICv3.3 detected at the GIC level, but the PE itself does not implement FEAT_NMI. How do we diagnose and resolve this NMI delivery failure? What is the relationship between GICv3.3 FEAT_GICv3_NMI and the PE-level FEAT_NMI?
